title: Add benchmark-lab profiling baselines and reporting pipeline v106
author: Aisha Patel
description: Context: This PR adds the v106 profiling baselines and an end-to-end reporting pipeline for the benchmark lab. Motivation: recent workload regressions showed variance in KV cache warmup and adaptive batching behavior across GPU types; we need stable baselines and a reliable pipeline to surface regressions automatically. What this PR does: adds representative workload runners for conversational and completion patterns; captures profiling baselines (latency P50/P95, memory, GPU utilization) for target model/sequence length combinations; implements a reporting pipeline that uploads aggregated metrics and artifacts to the benchmark-lab telemetry topic and to the BigQuery reporting dataset; wires baseline artifacts into the perf dashboard and alert rules. Checklist: [x] add representative runners; [x] capture profiling baselines; [x] implement reporting pipeline (pubsub -> ETL -> bigquery); [x] add unit and integration tests; [x] update docs and runbook. Rollout plan: merged to main, pipeline is feature-flagged and defaults to dry-run for the first week; alerts will be enabled after two successful daily runs. Related: ENG-1067 (profiling baselines), ENG-1092 (reporting pipeline), refs to earlier baseline work pr-562001 and pr-573210.
